lore: {name} turns blocks into their finer relatives, one deliberate tap at a time.
use: Right-click a block and it becomes the next block of its chain right where it stands (stone into chiseled stone bricks, planks into stairs, stairs into slabs). Sneak and right-click walks one step back and costs 2 durability. The tier decides which chains the chisel can work.
secret: The chains are datapack files, so other mods and packs can add their own blocks. The Fast Chiseling enchantment shortens the cooldown to 70 % (I) or 40 % (II).

lore: A short book of chisel chains and small corrections.
use: The Simple Chisels Guide explains the seven chisels, the tiers and Fast Chiseling. Craft it shapeless from a book and a chisel.
secret: Its chapters unlock as the matching recipes land in your recipe book. Nothing is consumed.
